<a id="T1"></a>**[T1]**

# CHAPTER ONE TEST SPELLS

These spells are made up for the tests.

### Flaming Teapot

**Missile**

Throws a flaming teapot. It does 1d burning damage per energy point.

<a id="T2"></a>**[T2]**

Cost: 1 to 3. The teapot breaks on impact; see [p. 3](#T3).

### Teapot Shield

**Blocking**

Stops one flaming teapot.

<a id="T3"></a>**[T3]**

# BREAKAGE

Broken teapots cost $10 to replace.
